spanButton.label: Span until latest goal/debt
spanButton.title: Set the horizon to span until your furthest-out goal or debt end date

firstShortfall.label: First shortfall
firstShortfall.captionPositive: balance stays above zero for the whole horizon

goalsOnTrack.label: Goals on track
goalsOnTrack.captionEmpty: no savings goals yet — add one below
goalsOnTrack.captionSomeBehind: details in the Goals card below

savingsChart.title: Projected savings per month
savingsChart.description: Built only from solid data: confirmed bills, each debt's installment schedule, and your 3-month card-spend average — one-off transfers never get spread across future months.

summary.startingBalanceCaption: Bank accounts + investments (not credit card balances)

cardSpendGoal.label: Monthly card spending goal
cardSpendGoal.editHintHousehold: Sum of each person's goal — set in each person's profile

detail.assumedTitle: Estimated from your 3-month average / spending goal — not a committed charge

whatIf.title: What-if
whatIf.description: Changes here update the charts above live — the gold badge marks them as hypothetical, with your real baseline dashed. Nothing is saved.

interestRate.label: Annual interest rate on idle cash: {{value}}%
interestRate.hint: (defaults to Brazil's Selic rate — edit if it's moved)

table.cardColumnTitle: On a credit card — left out of the projection since the card-spend goal/average already covers it
table.cardDisabledTitle: Charged to card — not part of the projection, so overriding has no effect

goals.title: Goals
goals.description: A target amount by a date, checked against your projected monthly savings rate.

table.name: Goal
table.empty: No goals yet — add one below to see whether your projected savings can reach it.
